what: Census of the forms archive of Urzad Miasta Bydgoszczy (templates published on the city's service cards)
method_note: Counts come from file geometry and text; no model was used. 'dotted' and 'boxes' follow a simple rule and are not approved fields.

class_meaning.fillable_pdf: PDF that declares its own fields: names and positions come from the file
class_meaning.vector_form: PDF with a text layer and places to fill found by the simple rule
class_meaning.word_form: word-processor file with places to fill found after conversion
class_meaning.pdf_text_no_blanks: PDF with a text layer, no places found: information sheet, or a form made of table cells
class_meaning.word_no_blanks: word-processor file, no places found: information sheet, or a form made of table cells
class_meaning.scan: PDF without a text layer: needs reading from pixels
class_meaning.other: not a document template (image, text, unknown type)
class_meaning.unreadable: could not be opened or converted in the time limit

timing_seconds.note: Time to read geometry and text of the whole archive on this machine. It is not the time to produce approved form descriptions.
